title: The Two Index Languages Are Logarithmic-Space Decidable
statement: Each of the two languages that, on an encoded pair $\langle u,\mathrm{bits}(i)\rangle$, respectively tests whether the $i$th bit of $u$ is true (with a missing bit treated as false) or whether $i<|u|$, is decidable in logarithmic space.
hypotheses_covered: An index j in the two-element set, selecting either the input-bit language or the input-length language
